name: Spire of Dublin
elevationDatum: Rigid exterior foundation plane y=0. Metres east/up/south; mapped orientation is baked once. No terrain, sea-level offset or Mercator scale is authored.
note: The designer’s120 m height takes precedence over the mapped121.2 m. The mapped footprint is used for center/alignment rather than diameter because its approximately2.2 m span disagrees with the published3 m base. Section-joint positions and plain base disc are estimates; the patterned base artwork and illumination perforations are omitted rather than copied. Tip lighting is represented by material colour with no emissive bloom. Cityscape: not tested. Full 3D world: not tested.
